svg.text: The ROAD from STANBYL to SVIDSVIKOV
in The Tsardom of Gyksvu · containing 115 leagues
as it was measured by the wayfarers' chain in the year 575
From Stanbyl to Radin 19, to Trinster 41, to Svorvlu 50, to Skeldil 58, to Kumelsk 79, to Bronstodin 93, to Svidsvikov 115 leagues
